---
title: "zillowdata"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(janitor)
library(ggalt)
library(ggrepel)
```

```{r}
zillow_data <- read_csv("zillow_zip_data.csv") |> rename(zip_code = RegionName) |> clean_names() |> mutate(city = if_else(city == "Vinings", "Atlanta", city)) 
```

```{r}
zillow_long <- zillow_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("x"),          # all those x1_31_00-style columns
    names_to = "date_raw",
    values_to = "median_price"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # remove "x" prefix and convert to real date
    date = mdy(str_remove(date_raw, "^x")),
    median_price = as.numeric(median_price)
  ) |>
  select(region_id, zip_code, state, city, date, median_price)


library(dplyr)

zillow_long <- zillow_long |>
  mutate(median_price = as.numeric(median_price)) |>
  group_by(zip_code) |>
  arrange(zip_code, date) |>
  mutate(
    initial_price = median_price[which.min(date)],  # find earliest observation per zip
    pct_change = (median_price - initial_price) / initial_price * 100
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
stadium_neighborhoods <- zillow_data |>
  filter(zip_code == 21201 | zip_code == 60613 | zip_code == 20003 | region_id == 58695 | zip_code == 33125 | zip_code == 30339 | zip_code == 15212 | zip_code == 11368 | zip_code == 14015 | zip_code == 19148 | zip_code == 33705 | zip_code == 77002 | zip_code == 76011 | zip_code == 48201 | zip_code == 44115 | zip_code == 45202 | zip_code == 60616 | zip_code == 53214 | zip_code == 63102 | zip_code == 64129 | zip_code == 55403 | zip_code == 80205 | zip_code == 85004 | zip_code == 92101 | zip_code == 90012 | zip_code == 92806 | zip_code == 94107 | zip_code == 94621 | zip_code == 98134) 

stadium_long <- stadium_neighborhoods |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("x"),          
    names_to = "date_raw",
    values_to = "median_price"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    date = mdy(str_remove(date_raw, "^x")),
    median_price = as.numeric(median_price)
  ) |>
  select(region_id, zip_code, state, city, date, median_price)  
  
stadium_long <- stadium_long |>
  mutate(median_price = as.numeric(median_price)) |>
  group_by(zip_code) |>
  arrange(zip_code, date) |>
  mutate(
    initial_price = median_price[which.min(date)],  
    pct_change = (median_price - initial_price) / initial_price * 100
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
stadium_long |>
  mutate(highlight = ifelse(city == "Baltimore", "Highlighted", "Other")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = pct_change, group = city)) +
  geom_line(
    data = stadium_long |> filter(city != "Baltimore"),
    color = "gray80",
    size = 1
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = stadium_long |> filter(city == "Baltimore"),
    color = "#FF8C00",
    size = 1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Highlighted" = "#FF8C00", "Other" = "gray80"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median home prices in baseball stadium zip codes",
    caption = "Source: Zillow sales data | Chart by Matt Cohen",
    x = "",
    y = "Median Home Price (USD)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5.5, 40, 5.5, 5.5))
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_dumbbell(
    data = stadium_neighborhoods,
    aes(y=city, x= x1_31_00, xend= x9_30_25),
    colour = "grey",
    colour_x = "red",
    colour_xend = "green"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Change in Median Home Prices from Jan 2000 to Sep 2025",
    x = "Median Home Price (USD)",
    y = "City"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() 
```
